response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS oa FROM Products), k AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.a FROM t JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL AND t.a > o.oa), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ma FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a FROM k JOIN m ON k.a > m.ma) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS avg_type_price, AVG(f.a - o.oa) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.a - m.ma) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM f CROSS JOIN o CROSS JOIN m
